meta.title: Pricing — Build Your Restaurant Plan from 9.90 €/mo | IQ Rest
meta.description: Build your plan from modules: QR menu with AI translation, order taking, table reservations, kitchen display. From 9.90 €/mo per restaurant, volume discounts. 14 days free, no card, cancel anytime.
meta.ogDescription: A modular plan from 9.90 €/mo: QR menu, orders, reservations, KDS. Volume discounts, no hidden fees. 14 days free.

faqSub: Common questions from restaurants about pricing and payment. Can't find yours — message us on WhatsApp.

faqItems.a: You build your plan from modules. The base is a QR menu with AI translation into 35 languages and management from any device. Then add what you need: table reservations, the kitchen display, your own domain. Pricing is per restaurant, with volume discounts starting from the second one.

faqItems.q: Is there a commission on orders?
faqItems.a: No. Orders from the QR menu and from waiters go directly to the restaurant. You pay only a fixed monthly price.

14 days of full access to every feature, no credit card needed. If payment isn't set up by the end, the account is paused: the panel stays available in view-only mode, while the guest menu and order taking are switched off. There are no automatic charges.

faqItems.q: What happens to my data while paused?
faqItems.a: Everything is kept: menu, photos, order history, bookings, settings, statistics. Set up payment even six months later — everything comes back exactly as it was.

faqItems.q: Will I have to reprint the QR codes?
faqItems.a: No. While paused, the codes show a "temporarily unavailable" notice; once payment is set up, the same codes open the menu again.
Yes, at any time from the panel. The difference is prorated over the remaining days of the paid period. A disabled feature keeps its data.

faqItems.q: How many restaurants can I connect?
faqItems.a: As many as you like, all managed from one panel. Volume discounts up to 50% with 5+ restaurants. For large chains — a custom plan via WhatsApp.

faqItems.q: What's the discount on the annual plan?
faqItems.a: About 30% compared to monthly billing. The exact amount is shown while building your plan.

faqItems.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
faqItems.a: In one click from the panel. The account works until the end of the paid period, then it's paused. Your data is kept.

faqItems.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faqItems.a: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Apple Pay, Google Pay — via Stripe. In Europe, the annual plan also supports SEPA Direct Debit.

finalCta.heading: One price. Zero risk.
finalCta.sub: No card needed, cancel anytime — trusted by {count} restaurants. All it takes to start is an email.
